يعتنقوا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَنِقُوا (yaʕtaniqū) /jaʕ.ta.ni.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# يُعْتَنَقُوا (yuʕtanaqū) /juʕ.ta.na.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
